descriptions.g5c_append_triple_80201160: Appends a three-word record to the external vector view at owner+44, using observed begin/end/capacity fields at44/48/56. Initializes a complete12-byte temporary, grows full storage by max(existing count, insertion count), copies existing records through null-checked placement construction, fills the inserted record, destroys old records and releases old storage. Uses original allocator and fallback boundaries; no external view is locally constructed and no initialized data is owned. Field names and container roles are inferred.
